1. Connect your phone and Meta Quest 3S to the same Wi-Fi.
2. In ZLNA, choose a video folder and tap Start.
3. Open Network in SKYBOX, refresh, and select ZLNA.

You can also connect the Quest to your phone’s hotspot. ZLNA detects either connection automatically.

Use 5 GHz Wi-Fi if available. When using a hotspot, turn off its automatic shutdown. Stop and restart sharing to pick up new videos.

If ZLNA does not appear, check that both devices are on the same network, the router allows devices to reach each other, and any phone VPN allows local traffic.

On MIX Flip 2, use the inner screen to find ZLNA under Settings → Outer screen → Outer screen apps. Add it to open ZLNA from the cover screen. If ZLNA is not listed, start sharing on the inner screen and check the notification on the cover screen. Unfold the phone if the folder picker or system settings require it.
